author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at the biggest companies in the world like Google implementing the most pointless of changes to do nothing other than cause the Internet to spiral as we know it. We have a silver lining in that the technology meant to replace us has been doing a terrible job each and every day and people are finally starting to realize. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: It's All Falling Apart...
